title: Make the complete QQ16 protected-return replay portable on Windows
body:
PR4790's complete QQ16 integration replay rejects valid source files on Windows before any return executes: retained PR2753 renders relative names with backslashes but compares them with a forward-slash inventory. This adds one isolated successor package, `research/qq16-portable-integration/`, that adapts exactly that expression in authenticated executable memory and reproduces the **complete original six-case receipt**.

The adapter requires exact hashes of both the original and transformed module. Frozen files, archives, source/hash inventories and mathematical guards remain intact. The unchanged PR4790 aggregator runs its six original workers through a destination-restricted facade, retaining isolation, fresh cache namespaces, optimization mode and timeouts. All 143 live inputs are pinned at starting main `cef4b52f2a59009865bf8eabde1be3f159063703`.

**Evidence at `a3632acbab32202015f0c5ecd11360e92e9a0f10`:**

- Both successful arms reproduce two generations and 24 real child calls each, including the later producer suffix. All four original rejection/cleanup cases match. The credited read/write/unit-move difference remains `(61488,24576,49200)`.
- Twelve new controls reject real authentication faults and alterations of the full retained receipt, including omitted cleanup and boolean/integer substitutions. The original selected-record compatibility controls also run.
- Metadata/pin validation and both registered commands pass on native Windows / CPython 3.12.0. Normal and optimized direct replay pass on Ubuntu/WSL / CPython 3.12.3 with identical JSON reports. The unchanged original full replay also passes on Linux.
- Exact committed-byte comparison passes for 148 files. The official 148-payload export passes integrity checking; both direct modes pass with all 149 exported files read-only and Git absent from PATH. Every exported byte remains unchanged; source corruption rejects in both modes. Export SHA256: `b48b4d5e5a44b9a0e6bb694184f46c195117e4721fc9e93d211ee9442c77c7c4`.
- Selected source-binding orientation passes. [Hosted CI](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39898635939) passed for this PR head: 362 helper tests (11 expected skips), both registered replay modes and the committed-input immutability check.

Reproduce:
```sh
python -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/qq16-portable-integration
```

**Limits:** this is a reproducibility extension using the original mathematical checker, not a new independent implementation. Reduced geometry only; the full-root census remains inherited evidence. No production O73 replay, complete D* versus B* cost, priced finite-control delta, all-size admission, new kappa or selected-frontier change. The optional full-history ancestry preflight was not run in this shallow checkout; all declared pins are available at the starting base.

Handoff-first selection, priority revision 7. [Canonical claim and findings](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4744#discussioncomment-19137557). Final overlap refresh covered 299 open PRs, 4,048 Discussion records and all 6,601 tracked top-level notes (04:01–04:03 UTC). Main was refreshed to `3fd7d441b898563fedb7dc45e5f926d937d4dfc8`; none of the 143 inputs or governing guidance changed. Arbitrary closed diffs and unpublished work remain outside this coverage.

Credit JoyboyBrian for #4790's composition/receipt; Chris R / Clear1nsight for #4166/#4167/#4172/#4177; DavidAriasC for PR2753 authentication; Mainzu for the earlier Windows observation in `selected-stock-rho-ledger`; Tekalign, Jose Manuel and the retained QQ16/native lineage. #4949 supplied the concrete handoff. New adapter and verification by Mihir Srivastava with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no subagents or independent human/formal review. Apache-2.0.
